# Supabase JavaScript client

`supabase-js-2.112.3.js` is the official browser bundle of
[`@supabase/supabase-js` 2.112.3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@supabase/supabase-js/v/2.112.3),
vendored so GolfCoach Pro does not rely on a mutable CDN at runtime.
